goal: Deep research: how to make heare (voice-first ambient agent) feel more 'alive' and powerful — perception, embodiment, closed-loop execution, memory, multi-channel output, safety, code quality, proactive triggers, local stack, voice UX, ecosystem, prior art, latency.

stages.name: Closed-loop execution — ReAct, self-verify, undo, dynamic chaining
Memory & persona evolution — auto-memory, preferences, mood model
Safety & policy — sandboxing, dry-run, diff preview, scope rules, audit
Anti-slop pass — concrete removal/refactor list from current code
Proactive triggers — file watches, git events, calendar, ambient audio
Local/offline stack — whisper.cpp, local LLM, local TTS, fallback design
Voice UX — barge-in, prosody, emotional TTS, voice cloning, non-verbal
Ecosystem — Raycast/Shortcuts/Alfred, git hooks, iOS companion, Apple Watch, HomeKit
Latency & pipeline performance — Pipecat tuning, streaming, TTFA budget

verification.method: inline cross-validation in report.md — 8 tensions identified and resolved across stages
